#2 The Factory tab: a pack's factory view declaration, discovered per project, opens a Software Factory section

Foundation for the Software Factory section (docs/factory-console/DESIGN.md: "Where it lives", "The factory view declaration", "Data"). Everything later builds on this.

**What to build**
- The factory view declaration schema in `packages/workflows/src/schemas/factory-view.ts` (zod; the schema is the owner, types derive from it), and discovery the way metric views are found (`packages/workflows/src/metric-views.ts`): the project file `.archon/packs/<pack key>.factory-view.json`, then `<pack>/.shared/factory-view.json` in project, global, installed and bundled packs. A malformed declaration is reported with its path, never silently skipped.
- `GET /api/factory/views?codebaseId=` in a new read-only route file `packages/server/src/routes/api.factory.ts`: the views that apply to the project (declaration found AND the project has a run of a workflow the view names, or the project file exists). Regenerate the web API types.
- The declaration for this repository's factory as the project file `.archon/packs/Wirasm.archon-software-factory.factory-view.json`, written against the pack's real workflows (`~/.archon-fc/plugins/` holds the installed pack, read-only; or github.com/Wirasm/archon-software-factory). Stages: Triage, Plan, Build, Checks, CI and review, Ready to land, Landed, with placement, endings, rounds, returns, change pointer and map layout per DESIGN.md. Step ids in events use `__` between include and inner node (seen live: `judge__judge`); check the real ids against the live database copy before writing `nodes`.
- A **Factory** tab after Runs, Chat, Metrics, shown only when a view applies to the project, and routes under `/console/p/:projectId/factory` (Overview, `board`, `items/:key`, `stages/:stage`, `steps/:workflow/:node`). This issue makes the Overview real at its top (title, summary paragraph, the sub-navigation Overview / Board / Needs you) and the other routes render a clear "coming next" placeholder with the back link.

**Done when**
- Unit tests: schema accepts the shipped declaration and rejects a malformed one with a readable path; discovery precedence (project file beats pack file); the applies-to-project rule.
- A server test for the route.
- In a browser (`bun run build:web && bun run dev:console`), the afc-project project shows the Factory tab and its Overview header with this factory's summary; a project with no view shows no tab. Say in the PR what you saw.

Size: m. Depends on nothing.
